findings.title: --next with a Your turn agent but no pane is now refused, not {focused:null, item, command}
findings.detail:
AC4 says 'output as cockpit --next printed'. The success JSON {focused, item} is kept, but the case 'oldest Your turn agent has no live pane / not in Herdr' used to exit 0 with focused:null and command; it now exits 3 nothing_to_attach with that command as do_instead. This matches AC3's rule for a unit with no live pane and is noted in the handoff. plugins/herdr/next.sh relies on the old shape until slice 15 rewrites it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Nothing in this slice; slice 15 AC2 must read the refusal (exit 3 + do_instead).

findings.title: listAgents failure is swallowed
findings.detail:
`cockpit.listAgents().catch(() => [])` turns a broken Herdr (socket gone, CLI error) into 'X has no live agent pane', which hides the real reason from the person.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optionally carry the error text into the refusal reason.
